item.title: Community Organizations Partner to Combat Elder Isolation with Holiday Celebration
item.description: (BENTON, Ky.) — A special Christmas party aimed at supporting isolated seniors across six western Kentucky counties will take place Tuesday morning, bringing together community partners committed to ensuring no elder is forgotten during the holiday season.

item.title: Grigg Shatters 28-Year-Old Scoring Record in Eagles Victory
item.description: (HOPKINSVILLE, Ky.) — History was made on the hardwood Monday night as Christian Fellowship School senior Elijah Grigg etched his name atop the school’s all-time scoring list, surpassing a record that had stood for nearly three decades.
